headline: Biel Crystal Stands as a Primary UTG Supplier for iPhone Duo
summary: The launch of Apple's first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, has brought ultra-thin flexible glass (UTG) into the industry spotlight. Leveraging extensive expertise in back-end precision finishing and large-scale delivery capabilities, Biel Crystal has become a core UTG supplier for the model.
